requirements.quote: Add the better-auth SSO plugin (new catalog dependency in pnpm-workspace.yaml and packages/auth/package.json)
SSO sign-in entry on the web sign-in page
an owner settings page to configure it
Acceptance: an organisation can sign in through SSO. [type:integration]

deliverables.change: Add catalog entry for @better-auth/sso pinned to the version matching better-auth 1.7.10 (verify on the registry).
Add "@better-auth/sso": "catalog:" to dependencies; update pnpm-lock.yaml via pnpm install (delete node_modules first if EACCES).
Lockfile update for the new dependency.

Register the sso plugin in createAuth mapped onto sso_provider (organisation-scoped, enabled-only), add 'sso' to SignInMethod and signInMethod() for the SSO callback paths, add SSO rate-limit customRules and a hooks.before per-domain limit, record sso sign-in success/failure through the SecurityEventRecorder, provision SSO users as plain members (never owner).
Add SSO limits (per IP per window, per domain-hash key via consumeRateLimit) and a key helper.
New: SSO helpers (domain normalisation, provider config validation, plugin schema mapping) with unit tests in packages/auth/src/__tests__/sso.test.ts.

Only if the installed plugin schema cannot map onto the table: additive nullable columns (plus migration with next free number and regenerated snapshot) and a narrow domain-lookup function exposing id/protocol/enabled but never config. Update packages/db/src/index.test.ts and RLS catalog tests if touched.
Add audit event types for SSO provider create/update/delete/enable and an sso sign-in method; update packages/core/src/audit/security-events.ts accordingly and their tests.

New owner-only core service (list/upsert/delete/enable provider for a workspace, writes audit row, never returns config secrets), exported via workspaces index; register in packages/db/src/testing/cross-tenant-registry.ts SERVICE_TESTS with real cases in packages/core/src/__tests__/cross-tenant/services.test.ts; update docs/engineering/core-domains.md only if a cross-domain import is added.
New SSO entry (work email -> start SSO) rendered from sign-in-form.tsx/page.tsx; same response for unknown domains (no enumeration); test in apps/web/__tests__/sign-in.test.tsx.

New owner-only settings page with actions.ts (workspaceAction, zod), loading.tsx, error.tsx; add its actions to ACTIONS and probe inputs in apps/web/__tests__/cross-tenant-actions.test.ts; link from settings nav.
Add SSO copy for sign-in and settings in en, kn and ta message files (use the existing auth namespace, or a new namespace registered in packages/i18n/src/catalog.ts and __tests__/catalog.test.ts).
Document the SSO plugin, domain lookup, provisioning role, rate limits (rate-limit table section) and audit events.

Integration test: mocked OIDC IdP, a user at a configured, enabled domain signs in via SSO and becomes a member of the organisation; disabled/unknown domain fails; rate limit returns 429; audit row recorded.

preserve.what: Magic link, passkey, Google and 2FA sign-in behaviour and rate limits in packages/auth/src/server.ts (existing packages/auth/src/__tests__/server.test.ts must pass unchanged).
createAuth(CreateAuthDeps) signature and the Auth type used by apps/web/lib/auth.ts and the admin console (disableSignUp, sessionExpiresInSeconds).
sso_provider table contract from #682: workspace_id RLS isolation, unique domain, config never exported (packages/db/src/schema/enterprise.ts, packages/db/src/__tests__/enterprise-schema.test.ts).
Existing SecurityEventRecorder interface consumers (packages/core/src/audit/security-events.ts) stay backward compatible; new methods have no-op defaults in noopSecurityEventRecorder.

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/auth exec vitest run src/__tests__/sso.test.ts src/__tests__/sso-sign-in.test.ts src/__tests__/server.test.ts src/__tests__/security-events.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}
pnpm --filter @causedeck/db exec vitest run src/__tests__/enterprise-schema.test.ts src/index.test.ts --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}

decisions.choice: New dependency @better-auth/sso added to the pnpm catalog and packages/auth only (third-party, not a workspace package).
decisions.justification: Issue text mandates it; sibling plugin precedent @better-auth/passkey at pnpm-workspace.yaml:55 and packages/auth/package.json:29.

decisions.choice: Provider writes go through an owner-only core service, not the plugin's registration endpoint; the plugin is mapped onto the existing sso_provider table.
decisions.justification: Table is tenant-scoped under FORCE RLS with secret config (packages/db/src/schema/enterprise.ts:45-70); workspace-scoped audit and owner policy live in core (packages/auth/src/policy/matrix.ts:10).

decisions.choice: Per-domain SSO rate limit reuses consumeRateLimit with a hashed key in the rate_limit table.
decisions.justification: Same mechanism as magic-link per-email limit, packages/auth/src/rate-limit.ts:21-50 and docs/engineering/auth.md:148-158.
